statements.text: The obligation to comply with Table 5-1 is created by ADD-03 Clause 7.1, which inserts Volume II Clause 5.6.

The letterhead, date, reference, subject and tender-reference lines only identify the letter and its issuer; they do not amend, oblige or except anything, so each has no effect of its own on the volumes or the register.

The table title and the lead-in sentence are a caption and an introduction ('as follows') with no shall/must/unless; the height limits are in the table rows (another batch) and are given effect by ADD-03 Clause 7.1, so these two blocks have no effect of their own.
